question: What mean Raman shift did the V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 show when the film was prestrained?
rendered: A mean red shift of ∼3.5 cm^−1 for V−O3−V (∼483 cm^−1) was observed when the V2O5 film was prestrained.
